newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends slightly lower in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends slightly lower in modest trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly weaker against its U.S. counterpart on Monday due to the greenback's recent strength overseas, but dealers said bargain-hunting trapped the rate in a narrow range.
The local unit rebounded from a morning low of T$27.570 to close at T$27.555 against Thursday's T$27.546.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$207 million.
Taiwan's markets were closed on Friday and Saturday due to national holidays.
"The rate still could not break out of range trading," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A T$27.52-58 range was seen for Tuesday.
